The fundraising journey

One partner from preparation
through to completion

Hedley Ventures combines hands-on fundraising support with CFO-level financial expertise to help founders prepare effectively, approach the right investors and navigate the fundraising process through to completion.

  1. 01

    Shape the investment story

    Develop the investment narrative and equity story, identifying the key KPIs and messages that underpin the raise.

  2. 02

    Get investor-ready

    Develop the pitch deck, refine the financial model and prepare the data room alongside supporting investor materials.

  3. 03

    Target the right investors

    Map, prioritise and approach the investors best aligned with the opportunity.

  4. 04

    Run the fundraising process

    Manage outreach, investor conversations, feedback, momentum and meeting preparation.

  5. 05

    Review & negotiate the term sheet

    Review terms, assess investor proposals and support commercial negotiations.

  6. 06

    Due diligence & completion

    Manage diligence workstreams and coordinate with lawyers to support the path through to completion.
